ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.

CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEMS 10A and 10B): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.

ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing of an Appeal filed by Pierre Joubert regarding the Planning Commission's approval of a Design Review Permit to add new parking spaces, construction of retaining walls that vary between 6 feet and 14 feet tall, and site and landscaping improvements for an existing office/commercial center. CASE NUMBER: 13-038 ADR; APPLICANT: North El Camino Real, LLC; LOCATION: 285 North El Camino Real (APNs: 257-062-26 and -29). Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso
Deny the appeal and modify the decision of the Planning Commission to approve the design of new parking spaces, retaining walls that vary between 6 feet and 14 feet tall, and site and landscaping improvements for an existing office/commercial center, with the subsequent modifications recommended by the Planning Commission; and adopt City Council Resolution of Approval 2016-04.
2016-01-20 Item 10A Appeal regarding 285 North El Camino Real - optimized
10B.
Public Hearing to consider two appeals of the Planning and Building Department's decision to approve and issue Building Permit Nos. 15-615 and 15-616 for the construction of a single-family home and detached garage. BUILDING PERMIT NOS.: 15-615 AND 15-616; APPLICANT: Andrew Smith; APPELLANTS: Charles and Suzanne Quirk and Patricia Roskowski; APPEAL CASE NOS.: 15-268 (Quirk) and 15-273 (Roskowski); LOCATION: 2344 8th Street. Contact Person: Associate Planner Innes
Deny the two appeals and adopt attached draft City Council Resolution No. 2016-14 upholding the Planning and Building Department decision to approve and issue Building Permit Nos. 15-615 and 15-616.
2016-01-20 Item 10B Appeal regarding 2344 8th Street

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
